nodes.label: Glowing bee-planet mark on a red-orange gradient
nodes.rationale: 1024×1024 PNG. Full-bleed square with a diagonal split from the left edge toward the top-right corner: deep red in the upper left, bright orange in the lower right, and a soft glow behind the mark. Centered is a yellow-white glyph: two short detached curved antennae, a dome, a thin tilted elliptical ring, and a four-lobed body with a vertical dark slit through the upper and lower lobes. No letters or wordmark.
